suggestions.title: One person, three jobs

edits.before: Here I’m going to talk about what you develop in yourself as you reparent your inner child. I’m going to talk about it in terms of three jobs: your loving Nurturer, your safe Adult Protector (hereafter just the Protector) and your wise Guide. That’s one grown-up doing three jobs, and each job keeps the others in balance. It’s you that needs to develop these qualities.

It’s you that needs to develop these qualities.

suggestions.title: Ask the guard what it wants first

edits.before: Instead, you might feel numb, cynical, angry, hungry, like you need to look at your phone, sexually aroused, like you need to make plans, sleepy, dissociated, or you might even think that what you're doing is stupid. Those are not failures. Often they are you experiencing a very charming guard. It's what protects you when your consciously installed parental Protector isn't functioning, the same as when you were a child. But before you decide where it's coming from, ask it what it's trying to stop, or what it wants. It could also be your inner child, mad that you took so long to come back, or your inherited parent script, or something from earlier today, or a bit of each.
edits.after: Instead, you might feel numb, cynical, angry, hungry, like you need to look at your phone, sexually aroused, like you need to make plans, sleepy, dissociated, or you might even think that what you're doing is stupid. Those are not failures. Often they are you experiencing a very charming guard. It's what protects you when your consciously installed parental Protector isn't functioning, the same as when you were a child. Before figuring out what/where it is, make sure to ask what it is trying to stop or what it wants. It may, of course, be your inner child, mad that it’s taken you so long to come back, or it may be your inherited parent script, or something from earlier in the day, or a bit of each.

suggestions.title: What the parent script is

edits.before: One important thing to become aware of when approaching your inner child is your inherited parent script. This is the set of rules and ways of treating yourself that you internalized as a child, mostly based on how your parent(s) treated you, and it doesn’t always sound like a voice. This is not the same as your inner adult (Nurturer, Protector, Guide) that you build up on purpose. Often this script acts as a critic or warden, telling your inner child not to cry, not to be “needy”, not to embarrass them, not to be too independent, etc. So when you begin talking to your child in a new, loving way, the script may jump in to say that what you’re doing is “fake”.
edits.after: One important thing to become aware of when approaching your inner child is your inherited parent script. Your parent script is made up of a collection of rules and ways of treating yourself that you adopted as a child (mostly based on how you were treated by your parent(s)). It doesn’t always take the form of a voice. This is not the inner adult (Nurturer, Protector, Guide) that you consciously build. Often this script acts as a critic or warden, telling your inner child not to cry, not to be “needy”, not to embarrass them, not to be too independent, etc. So when you begin talking to your child in a new, loving way, the script may jump in to say that what you’re doing is “fake”.

suggestions.title: The three stop words

edits.before: Deciding to do it. How will you coax yourself to do this? Make it spacious? Make it warm and held? Something else? Preview what you are going to do: will you close your eyes? Will you come out and go back in again? What will you do at the end? If you are going to use a recording, read the script if you can. Know that you can say "stop" at any time and the induction will end. If you want to change something, say "less" if you want it to be asking for less from you, or say "quiet" and the talking will stop. You can also just open your eyes and stop, and then come all the way back anyway. You don't need to ask any parts for permission to stop, even if a part tells you that you do.

Remind yourself that if you say 'stop' at any time, the induction will end. If you say 'less', you will be asked to do less. If you say 'quiet', the talking will stop. You can also just open your eyes and stop, and then come all the way back anyway. You don't need to ask any parts for permission to stop, even if a part tells you that you do.

suggestions.title: Big or hard-to-undo things wait

edits.before: Once you get an answer, you can ask: “What can I do in my ordinary life to prove that I heard correctly?” If it tells you to do something, I'd only do it if it's loving and leaves you free. It should make sense, too. Even then, anything big or hard to undo can wait until you're calm and you've checked it against what you actually know.

It should make sense to you and if it's something big or hard to undo, wait till you're calm and then check it out with what you know.

You don’t have to fix it. I’m here now, and the adult is here now to listen to you.” Make sure you are actually talking to your inner child, who is scared to death. No warmth today? Then rest your hands there and notice what you find, no faking required.

suggestions.title: Borrowing Nurturer and Protector

edits.before: This is NOT to say that you SHOULD use substances, but many people have used them when they first did self-hypnosis, contacted their inner child, or talked to their Higher Self. I’d learn the inner child work sober first, with enough Nurturer and Protector in the room before you go deep (see the inner child reparenting section). Borrowed is fine, as long as it’s from someone steady who won’t try to run your trip for you.
edits.after: This is NOT to say that you SHOULD use substances, but many people have used them when they first did self-hypnosis, contacted their inner child, or talked to their Higher Self. Borrow some from someone else if you need to, but make sure they're stable and not someone who will try to direct your trip.
